examples.en: I was thirsty and drank the water in one gulp.
The child swallowed the pill in one gulp.
I was nervous and swallowed hard.

examples.ko: 쓴 약이었지만 눈을 감고 꿀꺽 넘겼어요.
examples.en: The medicine was bitter, but I closed my eyes and got it down in one gulp.

examples.ko: 그는 꿀꺽 소리가 크게 나도록 주스를 다 마셨어요.
examples.en: He drank all the juice with a loud gulp.

examples.ko: 동생이 내 간식을 몰래 꿀꺽해 버렸어요.
examples.en: My younger sibling secretly gobbled up my snack.

explain: 꿀꺽은 음식이나 물을 한 번에 크게 삼키는 소리와 모양에 써요. 여러 번 마시면 '꿀꺽꿀꺽', 조금씩 마시면 '홀짝홀짝'이라고 해요. 놀라거나 긴장했을 때 '침을 꿀꺽 삼키다'라고 하고, '남의 것을 말없이 가지다'는 뜻으로도 입말에서 써요.
explain_en: 꿀꺽 is the sound and look of swallowing food or water in one big gulp. Repeated gulps are '꿀꺽꿀꺽' and small sips are '홀짝홀짝'. When surprised or tense you '침을 꿀꺽 삼키다', and in casual speech it can also mean quietly taking something that is not yours.

examples.en: Adding mung bean sprouts to bibimbap makes it crunchy and tasty.
I lightly blanch mung bean sprouts and season them as a side dish.
I bought a bag of mung bean sprouts at the market.
I piled lots of bean sprouts on my rice noodles.

examples.ko: 숙주나물이 상하기 쉬워서 빨리 먹어야 해요.
examples.en: Mung bean sprouts spoil easily, so you need to eat them quickly.

examples.ko: 어머니가 만든 숙주나물 무침이 제일 맛있어요.
examples.en: The seasoned bean sprouts my mother makes are the tastiest.

explain: 콩나물과 비슷하게 생겼지만 콩나물은 콩으로, 숙주나물은 녹두로 키워요. 줄여서 '숙주'라고도 하고, 쌀국수에 넣는 숙주도 같은 재료예요.
explain_en: It looks like '콩나물' (soybean sprouts), but '콩나물' is grown from soybeans and '숙주나물' from mung beans. It is often shortened to '숙주', and the sprouts put in rice noodle soup are the same ingredient.

examples.en: These days I eat multigrain rice every morning.
Multigrain rice is a bit coarser than white rice.
I ate multigrain rice with seasoned vegetable side dishes.
I switched because they say multigrain rice is good for health.
Please give me multigrain rice, not white rice.
Does this restaurant offer multigrain rice too?

explain: 쌀에 보리, 콩, 수수 같은 여러 곡식을 섞어 지은 밥이에요. 보리만 섞으면 '보리밥', 현미로 지으면 '현미밥'이라고 따로 부르기도 해요.
explain_en: It is rice cooked with a mix of grains such as barley, beans and sorghum. If only barley is mixed in it is called '보리밥', and rice made with brown rice is '현미밥'.

examples.en: Pine nut porridge is soft and good when you are sick.
I bought a bag of pine nuts at the supermarket.
Pine nuts are floating on the sujeonggwa.
I got a snack made of pine nuts as a gift.
I sprinkled a handful of pine nuts on the salad.
Pine nuts are nutty but expensive.

explain: 잣은 잣나무의 씨앗이라 고소하고 값이 비싼 편이에요. 잣죽, 수정과, 한과처럼 한국 음식에 자주 들어가고, 음식 위에 올리는 고명으로도 많이 써요. 호두보다 훨씬 작고 부드러워요.
explain_en: Pine nuts are the seeds of the Korean pine, rich in flavor and rather expensive. They go into Korean dishes such as 잣죽, 수정과 and 한과, and are often used as a garnish called 고명. They are much smaller and softer than 호두 (walnuts).

examples.en: The meat is sizzling in the pan.
I like the sound of pork belly sizzling.
Turn down the heat when the oil starts to sizzle.
The frying pan sizzled and a delicious smell came out.
The sausage sizzled on the hot griddle.
The sizzling sound had stopped before I knew it.

explain: 뜨거운 기름이나 불판에서 고기, 전이 익을 때 나는 소리를 나타내서 영어로는 sizzle에 가까워요. 같은 소리를 '지글지글'이라고도 해요. '보글보글'은 찌개처럼 국물이 끓는 소리라서 달라요.
explain_en: It describes the sound of meat or pancakes cooking on hot oil or a griddle, closer to English 'sizzle'. The sound word '지글지글' is the same thing. '보글보글' is different: it is the bubbling of a stew or soup.
